summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for fixing Android 8 full-screen Dialog bottom cropping and frame drops, adding the new 4th 'Sticky' tab with adaptive wall layout and rich formatting/tables/attachments, adding voice/PDF/image attachments to transactions, overhauling Profile vs. Extras linked/sandboxed accounts with de-link data handling, adding Hotel/Account call/contact popups and short notes, adding Bold Text and fixing Text Size scaling, unifying Hotel/Account info cards & popups, optimizing tablet layouts, and fixing Meal Ledger and Paid Status backup/UI bugs.
